name: Exterior Trim Repaint Finish Coat
intent: Single finish coat. Listed twice in scenarios for 2-coat system. Brush 40 LF/hr, spray 125 LF/hr (RP rates slightly different from NC).
doctrine: RP finish brush rate (40 LF/hr) is slightly slower than NC (50 LF/hr) — repaint surfaces have more variation requiring careful brush work. Spray rate (125 LF/hr) matches NC spray. Module listed twice in scenarios for 2-coat system.
